history.summary: A very large 2,174 sqft 4BR EC in Punggol (Twin Waterfalls, D19) at $2.8M / $1,288 psf — a high quantum into a thin, family-only buyer band with LRT-only connectivity. No URA appreciation data and an oversized layout that inflates the absolute ticket make this a difficult 5-7yr investment exit.
history.rating_rationale: $2.8M for a 4BR sits well above the $1.8-2.5M deepest-liquidity band, and the 2,174 sqft is genuinely oversized for the bedroom count — the low $1,288 psf is a function of size, not value. 850m to Soo Teck LRT (not MRT) plus OCR Punggol means a transit-dependent, niche resale pool. No project URA appreciation/txn data to anchor an upside case. Punggol Digital District is a real catalyst but does not rescue a $2.8M quantum.
red_flags: $2.8M is well above the deep buyer band — narrow family-only exit
Oversized 2,174 sqft 4BR inflates the ticket; low psf is a size artifact
LRT-only (850m), no MRT — transit-dependent in OCR Punggol

catalysts: Punggol Digital District + SIT campus driving precinct demand
99LH EC, fully privatised pricing in a maturing estate
Large dual-key-capable layout appeals to multi-gen families

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Punggol rental demand is steady but rents on a 2,174 sqft unit yield poorly against a $2.8M base — sub-3% gross; tenant pool for very large units is shallow.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: No project URA data; D19 OCR baseline ~3.7%/yr. PDD provides upside but the oversized 4BR format is the weakest-appreciating configuration in any estate.
